name: lt08-migrant-surge-s0

fort.note: Public forts: CLI seeds (docker/task_forts.sh, as runner/yukon/setup.sh). Private forts: pool/dfpool (seeds drawn per season, committed in pool/seasons/<season>/COMMITMENT.json, revealed at close).

pool_note: Private pool (pool/README.md): `snapshot_pool_private` holds placeholders that `pool/dfpool stage` resolves to the season's sealed forts (scenarios/snapshots/<season>-<task>-p<i> under DFBENCH_SNAPSHOTS_DIR); the staged copy drops `snapshot` and replaces `snapshot_pool`. Without staging, the task runs on the public `snapshot_pool` below (competitors' local runs).
description: Seed-built LT08 (docs/SEED-FORTS.md). A working year-1 fort (embark/forts/worked-y1: about 19 dwarves, 19 unplaced beds, Carpenters/Still/Kitchen, two underground plump-helmet plots, 571 drink) gets two migrant waves: migrant_surge.lua raises the caravan report to 100000 and queues a wave at load, and the fort's pending spring Migrants event (spring tick 4087, set by the recipe as on scripted-y1) brings a second. Past 20 citizens new work orders need the manager's assigned office with a chair (the agent sets that up itself).
goal: Migrants are arriving. From day 39 you can't act for 21 days. By day 60 every dwarf must have a placed bed, drink and food must be in stock every day from day 39, and drink must not end lower than it was on day 39. No dwarf may die.
brief: A large wave of migrants is arriving, and more are expected. The fortress has beds for its current dwarves, but none are placed.
provenance: Start: embark/forts/worked-y1.json on a fresh TEMPERATE_SOIL embark of each pool seed (embark/make_task_fort.sh), in place of the scripted-y1 snapshot. Setup unchanged from lt08-migrant-surge (migrant_surge.lua 100000). The brief no longer says '19 dwarves' (the seed-built fort has 17-19). Season-0 copy of scenarios/seed/lt08-migrant-surge.json with the private-pool placeholders.
